description: Tunable parameters for the Tone-Aware Review Voice Agent v2. All magic numbers live here — pipeline code reads this file and never hardcodes these values.

routing_rules.condition: intensity >= 0.7 AND primary_emotion IN voice_dominant_emotions AND mismatch == false
routing_rules.description: High-intensity raw emotions — Voice Model carries the emotion through prosody/SSML.

routing_rules.condition: intensity >= 0.7 AND primary_emotion IN llm_dominant_emotions AND mismatch == false
routing_rules.description: High-intensity text-dependent emotions — LLM carries the emotion through word choice.

routing_rules.condition: intensity >= 0.3 AND intensity < 0.7 AND mismatch == false
routing_rules.description: Mid-intensity emotions — both LLM and Voice Model share the emotional load equally.
Low-intensity/neutral text — star rating sets the base vibe via speed only.
Star-text mismatch ALWAYS routes to LLM — linguistic contradictions need the right words.

routing_priority_note: R5 (mismatch) is checked FIRST regardless of intensity.

high_star_negative_text.description: 4-5 stars with angry/sarcastic/disappointed text → trust the text, dampen speed

low_star_positive_text.description: 0-1 stars with warm/positive text → blend both, lean toward text warmth

voice_id_note: Kokoro prefixes: af_*/am_*=American F/M, bf_*/bm_*=British F/M, hf_*/hm_*=Hindi F/M. Valid Hindi male voices are hm_omega, hm_psi (hm_alpha does NOT exist and 404s on HuggingFace).
